description: Whatever is sent, more is needed, because the currency keeps moving and the needs are medical. There is no amount that discharges it.
energy_note: A bill that is never paid in full.

aspect: It arrives with a premium and a risk
description: Formal channels are closed, so the transfer goes through informal networks at a spread, with counterparty risk and legal exposure on both ends.
energy_note: A five percent fee and a criminal risk.

aspect: It sets the terms of every family conversation
description: The sender cannot refuse without appearing to abandon; the receiver cannot ask without appearing to demand. Both learn to talk around it, permanently.
energy_note: A subject the whole family talks around.

aspect: It delays the sender's own life by a decade
description: Deposit, pension, training, children - all deferred to fund a household in another country. Measured at 60, the cost of the remittance decade is not recoverable.
energy_note: Your thirties, spent on somebody else's survival.
